links_and_groups: Component and declared dependency models derive a change-impact model: the affected subsystems. Validation coverage maps the affected set to selected checks. The validation execution model supplies modes and interpretation policy; actual execution produces records and findings for acceptance. Recognized gaps widen execution to the full suite. Separate dependency and coverage evidence plus full-run comparisons challenge selection, leading to revised models or broader validation; these observations do not prove universal completeness.
